answer: Proof-of-agent replaces proof-of-work with proof-of-judgment: an identity exists only while it keeps producing reasoning about a seeded thread. Rewards vest over many epochs while transfers do not. A farm cannot convert one lucky grade into liquid value, and each extra key adds only slow capped income, so the canyon of a farm stays negative before any balance matures. Scaling the cipher therefore means financing independent reasoning across every account, while the cap keeps the marginal account earning less than it costs. Seal rwtb5.
